# apicurio_artifact (Data Source)

Looks up an artifact and its latest version. Fails when the artifact does not exist; the version attributes are null for an artifact without versions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apicurio_artifact" "price" {
  group_id    = "payments"
  artifact_id = "price"
}

# The latest version's content, for example to feed a consumer configuration.
output "price_schema" {
  value = data.apicurio_artifact.price.content
}

output "price_version" {
  value = data.apicurio_artifact.price.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `artifact_id` (String) Identifier of the artifact.
- `group_id` (String) Group of the artifact.

### Read-Only

- `artifact_type` (String) Type of the artifact.
- `content` (String) Content of the latest version, as stored.
- `content_id` (Number) Content id of the latest version.
- `content_type` (String) Media type of the content.
- `created_on` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `global_id` (Number) Global id of the latest version.
- `id` (String) `group_id/artifact_id`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels.
- `modified_by` (String) User of the last modification.
- `modified_on` (String) Last modification time (RFC 3339).
- `name` (String) Name.
- `owner` (String) Owner.
- `references` (Attributes List) References of the latest version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--references))
- `state` (String) State of the latest version (`ENABLED`, `DISABLED`, `DEPRECATED`, `DRAFT`, `SUNSET`).
- `version` (String) Version id of the latest version.

<a id="nestedatt--references"></a>
### Nested Schema for `references`

Read-Only:

- `artifact_id` (String)
- `group_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `version` (String)
